ofertas.titulo: Photorealistic composite for a single cover (photo manipulation)
ofertas.descripcion:
I'm an independent R&B/soul artist looking for a photo-manipulation artist to create the cover of my debut single. It must look like a real photograph of an impossible place, not a painting or digital illustration.
The image: a lone, free-standing limestone arch covered in ivy, in a daylit meadow of wild red anemones with mountains and cedar trees behind it. Through the arch is a different world at night: a jade-green crescent moon, tall moonlit peaks, waterfalls and mist. Green-gold light from the doorway spills onto the meadow.
It should feel inspired, safe and free: wonder, not threat. I have a composition rough and a full written brief to share once we're talking.
Please apply with:
- 2-3 photorealistic composites from your portfolio, ideally mixing different light sources or day and night
- Your price, including the rights below
- Confirmation you can meet the dates
No AI-generated elements. All source images must be your own or licensed for commercial use.

ofertas.titulo: Freelance Video Editor / Motion Designer / 3D Animator (Remote)
ofertas.descripcion:
Quantumstrat is a B2B electronics trading company that also runs a creative studio division producing video and animation for US marketing agencies and brands. We're expanding that division and building a bench of freelance editors and animators who produce work at a US-agency standard: fast, clean, on-brand, and ready to ship. You'll work remotely on projects for our US clients — short-form social, YouTube, brand films, commercials, explainers, product animation and more.
 We're hiring for four tracks (apply to one or more):
 Video Editor — Premiere Pro (plus After Effects for titles/graphics). Short-form social (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), YouTube long-form, corporate, commercial and documentary-style edits. Strong pacing, sound design and color awareness.
 Motion Graphics / 2D Animator — After Effects. Explainers, kinetic typography, animated titles, logo stings, social ad variations, character/2D animation.
 3D Animator — Blender or Cinema 4D (plus After Effects compositing). Product visualization, how-it-works animations, 3D motion for ads.
 Colorist / Finishing Editor — DaVinci Resolve. Color grading, conform, finishing, delivery specs for broadcast and digital.
 What we need from you 
 A portfolio that holds up next to US agency work — this is the main thing we judge on
 3+ years of professional editing or animation experience (agency, studio or serious freelance)
 Expert in your primary tool: Premiere Pro, After Effects, Blender/Cinema 4D or DaVinci Resolve; Photoshop/Illus

I’m looking for an experienced Squarespace designer to redesign my existing eight-page personal
training and wellness website.
The website is already live and contains most of the required pages and content. However, the
current design feels dated and no longer reflects the professional direction of the brand. I would
like the website to have a cleaner, more sophisticated, and modern appearance while remaining
warm and approachable to potential clients.
This is primarily a redesign and content update project. The existing website structure and
content can be used as a starting point, but the selected freelancer should improve how the
information is organized and presented across the website.
Some updated text and images will be provided to replace existing content. The homepage and
service pages will require the most attention, but the new visual direction should be applied
consistently across all eight pages.
The project will include:
• Redesigning the existing eight-page Squarespace website
• Creating a more polished and consistent visual direction
• Improving the homepage layout and presentation
• Making the personal training and wellness services easier to understand
• Improving the visual hierarchy of headings, text, images, and buttons
• Updating selected text, images, and website sections
• Improving spacing, alignment, typography, and section flow
• Strengthening the navigation and overall user experience
• Connecting important buttons to the correct pages or sections
